title: "Module 13: Spatial cell-type deconvolution with CARD"

```{r}
#==============================================================================
# MODULE 14 — Spatial CARD cell-type deconvolution
#==============================================================================

# Purpose:
#   Perform CARD spatial cell-type deconvolution using the SingleR-annotated
#   scRNA-seq reference generated in Module 04 and the final inferCNV +
#   SingleR spatial Seurat object generated in Module 12.
#
#   CARD is run independently on each Visium slide using raw scRNA-seq RNA
#   counts, fine SingleR reference labels, raw Spatial counts, and spatial
#   tissue coordinates. Estimated cell-type proportions are saved, mapped
#   back into the master spatial Seurat object, summarized using the top three
#   predicted cell types per spot, visualized spatially, and saved as a final
#   reusable inferCNV + SingleR + CARD spatial checkpoint.
#
# Inputs:
#   data/processed/single_cell/
#     GSE298688_SingleR_annotated_seurat.rds
#
#   data/processed/spatial/
#     spatial_tumor_final_infercnV_singleR.rds
#
# Primary CARD objects:
#   data/processed/spatial/CARD/
#
# Final CARD-annotated spatial object:
#   data/processed/spatial/
#     spatial_tumor_final_infercnV_singleR_CARD.rds
#
# Output tables:
#   results/spatial/CARD/
#   results/spatial/CARD/per_sample/
#
# Output figures:
#   figures/spatial/CARD/
#   figures/spatial/CARD/SpatialFeaturePlots/
#
# CARD reference:
#   Assay:             RNA
#   Cell-type column:  SingleR_fine_pruned
#
# CARD spatial input:
#   Assay:             Spatial
#   Sample column:     sample
#
# CARD filtering:
#   minCountGene:      200
#   minCountSpot:      50
#
# Derived CARD metadata:
#   CARD_identity
#   CARD_max_score
#   CARD_second_identity
#   CARD_second_score
#   CARD_third_identity
#   CARD_third_score
#   CARD_margin
#   CARD_top3_total
#   CARD_top3_label
#   CARD_<cell_type>
#
# Notes:
#   - CARD estimates proportional cell-type contributions within each Visium
#     spot. These are model-based composition estimates, not direct cell counts.
#   - CARD proportions should not be interpreted as proof of a single pure cell
#     identity within a spatial spot.
#   - Raw counts are required for both the scRNA-seq reference and spatial data.
#==============================================================================


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Load required packages
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Seurat)
  library(SeuratObject)
  library(CARD)
  library(Matrix)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(patchwork)
  library(scales)
  library(here)
})


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Reproducibility settings
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

set.seed(1234)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Define analysis parameters
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

reference_assay <- "RNA"

reference_cell_type_column <- "SingleR_fine_pruned"

reference_sample_column <- "sample"

spatial_assay <- "Spatial"

spatial_sample_column <- "sample"

minimum_shared_genes <- 1000

card_min_count_gene <- 200

card_min_count_spot <- 50

run_card_imputation <- FALSE

card_num_grids <- 2000

card_num_neighbors <- 10


sample_order <- c(
  "Normal_Tissue",
  "Vehicle_1",
  "Vehicle_2",
  "Niacin_Treatment"
)


sample_images <- c(
  Normal_Tissue = "Naive_A9",
  Vehicle_1 = "Vehicle1_C5",
  Vehicle_2 = "Vehicle2_D5",
  Niacin_Treatment = "Niacin2_B5"
)


sample_titles <- c(
  Normal_Tissue = "Normal Tissue",
  Vehicle_1 = "Vehicle 1",
  Vehicle_2 = "Vehicle 2",
  Niacin_Treatment = "Niacin Treatment"
)


selected_card_cell_types <- c(
  "Macrophages",
  "Macrophages activated",
  "Microglia",
  "Microglia activated",
  "Monocytes"
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Define repository paths
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

single_cell_processed_directory <- here::here(
  "data",
  "processed",
  "single_cell"
)

spatial_processed_directory <- here::here(
  "data",
  "processed",
  "spatial"
)

card_object_directory <- here::here(
  "data",
  "processed",
  "spatial",
  "CARD"
)

results_directory <- here::here(
  "results",
  "spatial",
  "CARD"
)

per_sample_results_directory <- here::here(
  "results",
  "spatial",
  "CARD",
  "per_sample"
)

figure_directory <- here::here(
  "figures",
  "spatial",
  "CARD"
)

spatial_feature_directory <- here::here(
  "figures",
  "spatial",
  "CARD",
  "SpatialFeaturePlots"
)


directories_to_create <- c(
  card_object_directory,
  results_directory,
  per_sample_results_directory,
  figure_directory,
  spatial_feature_directory
)

for (directory in directories_to_create) {
  dir.create(
    directory,
    recursive = TRUE,
    showWarnings = FALSE
  )
}


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Define input and output files
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

reference_file <- file.path(
  single_cell_processed_directory,
  "GSE298688_SingleR_annotated_seurat.rds"
)

spatial_file <- file.path(
  spatial_processed_directory,
  "spatial_tumor_final_infercnv_singleR.rds"
)

final_card_object_file <- file.path(
  spatial_processed_directory,
  "spatial_tumor_final_infercnv_singleR_CARD.rds"
)

all_card_results_file <- file.path(
  card_object_directory,
  "spatial_CARD_all_results.rds"
)

all_card_identities_file <- file.path(
  card_object_directory,
  "spatial_CARD_top3_identities.rds"
)

reference_metadata_file <- file.path(
  results_directory,
  "CARD_reference_metadata.csv"
)

reference_summary_file <- file.path(
  results_directory,
  "CARD_reference_summary.csv"
)

shared_gene_summary_file <- file.path(
  results_directory,
  "CARD_shared_gene_summary.csv"
)

top3_summary_file <- file.path(
  results_directory,
  "CARD_top3_spot_summary.csv"
)

identity_summary_file <- file.path(
  results_directory,
  "CARD_identity_by_sample.csv"
)

metadata_file <- file.path(
  results_directory,
  "spatial_infercnv_singleR_CARD_metadata.csv"
)

parameter_file <- file.path(
  results_directory,
  "CARD_parameters.csv"
)

session_info_file <- file.path(
  results_directory,
  "CARD_sessionInfo.txt"
)


cat(
  "\n============================================================\n",
  "MODULE 14 — Spatial CARD deconvolution\n",
  "============================================================\n",
  "Repository root:       ", here::here(), "\n",
  "scRNA reference:       ", reference_file, "\n",
  "Spatial input:         ", spatial_file, "\n",
  "CARD objects:          ", card_object_directory, "\n",
  "Results directory:    ", results_directory, "\n",
  "Figure directory:     ", figure_directory, "\n",
  "Final spatial object: ", final_card_object_file, "\n",
  "============================================================\n\n",
  sep = ""
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Validate required upstream files
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

required_input_files <- c(
  reference_file,
  spatial_file
)

missing_input_files <- required_input_files[
  !file.exists(required_input_files)
]

if (length(missing_input_files) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Required CARD input file(s) were not found:\n",
    paste(
      missing_input_files,
      collapse = "\n"
    )
  )
}

cat(
  "Required CARD input files were found.\n"
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Load SingleR-annotated scRNA-seq reference
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Loading SingleR-annotated scRNA-seq reference\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)

reference_object <- readRDS(
  reference_file
)

if (!inherits(reference_object, "Seurat")) {
  stop(
    "Single-cell reference is not a valid Seurat object."
  )
}

if (!reference_assay %in% names(reference_object@assays)) {
  stop(
    "Reference assay was not found: ",
    reference_assay
  )
}

if (!reference_cell_type_column %in%
    colnames(reference_object@meta.data)) {
  stop(
    "CARD reference cell-type column was not found: ",
    reference_cell_type_column
  )
}

cat(
  "Reference object loaded successfully:\n",
  "  Genes: ", nrow(reference_object), "\n",
  "  Cells: ", ncol(reference_object), "\n",
  sep = ""
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Load final spatial Seurat object
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Loading final spatial Seurat object\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)

spatial_object <- readRDS(
  spatial_file
)

if (!inherits(spatial_object, "Seurat")) {
  stop(
    "Spatial input file is not a valid Seurat object."
  )
}

if (!spatial_assay %in% names(spatial_object@assays)) {
  stop(
    "Spatial assay was not found: ",
    spatial_assay
  )
}

if (!spatial_sample_column %in%
    colnames(spatial_object@meta.data)) {
  stop(
    "Spatial sample column was not found: ",
    spatial_sample_column
  )
}

cat(
  "Spatial object loaded successfully:\n",
  "  Genes:  ", nrow(spatial_object), "\n",
  "  Spots:  ", ncol(spatial_object), "\n",
  "  Slides: ",
  length(
    unique(
      spatial_object@meta.data[[spatial_sample_column]]
    )
  ),
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)

cat(
  "\nSpatial samples:\n"
)

print(
  table(
    spatial_object@meta.data[[spatial_sample_column]]
  )
)

cat(
  "\nSpatial images:\n"
)

print(
  Seurat::Images(
    spatial_object
  )
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 9. Prepare scRNA-seq reference counts
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Preparing scRNA-seq CARD reference counts\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)

Seurat::DefaultAssay(
  reference_object
) <- reference_assay

reference_layers <- SeuratObject::Layers(
  reference_object[[reference_assay]]
)

cat(
  "Reference RNA assay layers:\n"
)

print(
  reference_layers
)

reference_count_layers <- grep(
  "^counts",
  reference_layers,
  value = TRUE
)

if (length(reference_count_layers) == 0) {
  stop(
    "No raw RNA counts layer was found in the scRNA-seq reference."
  )
}

if (length(reference_count_layers) > 1) {
  cat(
    "Multiple reference RNA count layers detected.\n",
    "Joining RNA layers...\n",
    sep = ""
  )

  reference_object <- SeuratObject::JoinLayers(
    reference_object,
    assay = reference_assay
  )
}

reference_counts <- SeuratObject::LayerData(
  object = reference_object,
  assay = reference_assay,
  layer = "counts"
)

reference_counts <- methods::as(
  reference_counts,
  "dgCMatrix"
)

if (nrow(reference_counts) == 0 ||
    ncol(reference_counts) == 0) {
  stop(
    "Reference raw count matrix is empty."
  )
}


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 10. Construct CARD reference metadata
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

reference_cell_types <- as.character(
  reference_object@meta.data[
    colnames(reference_counts),
    reference_cell_type_column
  ]
)

if (reference_sample_column %in%
    colnames(reference_object@meta.data)) {
  reference_sample_info <- as.character(
    reference_object@meta.data[
      colnames(reference_counts),
      reference_sample_column
    ]
  )
} else if ("orig.ident" %in%
           colnames(reference_object@meta.data)) {
  reference_sample_info <- as.character(
    reference_object@meta.data[
      colnames(reference_counts),
      "orig.ident"
    ]
  )
} else {
  reference_sample_info <- rep(
    "Reference",
    ncol(reference_counts)
  )
}

reference_metadata <- data.frame(
  cellType = reference_cell_types,
  sampleInfo = reference_sample_info,
  row.names = colnames(reference_counts),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 11. Remove invalid reference annotations
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

invalid_reference_labels <- c(
  "",
  "Uncertain",
  "Unassigned",
  "Unknown",
  "NA"
)

valid_reference_cells <- rownames(reference_metadata)[
  !is.na(reference_metadata$cellType) &
  !reference_metadata$cellType %in%
    invalid_reference_labels
]

reference_metadata <- reference_metadata[
  valid_reference_cells,
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

reference_counts <- reference_counts[
  ,
  valid_reference_cells,
  drop = FALSE
]

if (!identical(
  colnames(reference_counts),
  rownames(reference_metadata)
)) {
  stop(
    "Reference counts and CARD metadata are not aligned."
  )
}


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 12. Summarize CARD reference
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

reference_cell_types <- sort(
  unique(
    reference_metadata$cellType
  )
)

reference_cell_type_counts <- sort(
  table(
    reference_metadata$cellType
  ),
  decreasing = TRUE
)

cat(
  "\nCARD reference summary:\n",
  "  Genes:      ", nrow(reference_counts), "\n",
  "  Cells:      ", ncol(reference_counts), "\n",
  "  Cell types: ", length(reference_cell_types), "\n",
  sep = ""
)

cat(
  "\nReference cell-type counts:\n"
)

print(
  reference_cell_type_counts
)

reference_summary <- data.frame(
  cell_type = names(reference_cell_type_counts),
  cells = as.integer(reference_cell_type_counts),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

utils::write.csv(
  reference_summary,
  reference_summary_file,
  row.names = FALSE
)

reference_metadata_export <- reference_metadata

reference_metadata_export$cell <- rownames(
  reference_metadata_export
)

utils::write.csv(
  reference_metadata_export,
  reference_metadata_file,
  row.names = FALSE
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 13. Define function to extract CARD-compatible coordinates
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

get_CARD_coordinates <- function(
    sample_object,
    image_name
) {
  coordinates <- Seurat::GetTissueCoordinates(
    sample_object,
    image = image_name
  )

  coordinates <- as.data.frame(
    coordinates
  )

  if (all(c("x", "y") %in% colnames(coordinates))) {
    coordinates <- coordinates[
      ,
      c("x", "y"),
      drop = FALSE
    ]

  } else if (all(
    c("imagecol", "imagerow") %in%
      colnames(coordinates)
  )) {
    coordinates <- coordinates[
      ,
      c("imagecol", "imagerow"),
      drop = FALSE
    ]

    colnames(coordinates) <- c(
      "x",
      "y"
    )

  } else if (all(
    c("col", "row") %in%
      colnames(coordinates)
  )) {
    coordinates <- coordinates[
      ,
      c("col", "row"),
      drop = FALSE
    ]

    colnames(coordinates) <- c(
      "x",
      "y"
    )

  } else {
    stop(
      "Could not identify CARD-compatible x/y coordinate columns.\n",
      "Available columns: ",
      paste(
        colnames(coordinates),
        collapse = ", "
      )
    )
  }

  return(
    coordinates
  )
}


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 14. Define function to run CARD on one spatial slide
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

run_CARD_sample <- function(
    spatial_object,
    sample_name,
    reference_counts,
    reference_metadata,
    reference_cell_types,
    spatial_assay,
    spatial_sample_column,
    image_name,
    card_object_directory,
    per_sample_results_directory,
    min_count_gene,
    min_count_spot,
    minimum_shared_genes
) {

  cat(
    "\n============================================================\n",
    "RUNNING CARD — ",
    sample_name,
    "\n",
    "============================================================\n",
    sep = ""
  )


  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Subset sample
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------

  sample_spots <- colnames(spatial_object)[
    spatial_object@meta.data[[spatial_sample_column]] ==
      sample_name
  ]

  if (length(sample_spots) == 0) {
    warning(
      "No spatial spots were found for ",
      sample_name
    )

    return(NULL)
  }

  sample_object <- subset(
    spatial_object,
    cells = sample_spots
  )

  if (!image_name %in% Seurat::Images(sample_object)) {
    stop(
      "Expected spatial image was not found for ",
      sample_name,
      ": ",
      image_name
    )
  }


  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Prepare raw Spatial counts
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------

  sample_layers <- SeuratObject::Layers(
    sample_object[[spatial_assay]]
  )

  sample_count_layers <- grep(
    "^counts",
    sample_layers,
    value = TRUE
  )

  if (length(sample_count_layers) == 0) {
    stop(
      "No raw Spatial counts were found for ",
      sample_name
    )
  }

  if (length(sample_count_layers) > 1) {
    sample_object <- SeuratObject::JoinLayers(
      sample_object,
      assay = spatial_assay
    )
  }

  spatial_counts <- SeuratObject::LayerData(
    object = sample_object,
    assay = spatial_assay,
    layer = "counts"
  )

  spatial_counts <- methods::as(
    spatial_counts,
    "dgCMatrix"
  )


  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Extract coordinates
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------

  coordinates <- get_CARD_coordinates(
    sample_object = sample_object,
    image_name = image_name
  )

  common_spots <- intersect(
    colnames(spatial_counts),
    rownames(coordinates)
  )

  if (length(common_spots) == 0) {
    stop(
      "No matching count/coordinate barcodes were found for ",
      sample_name
    )
  }

  spatial_counts <- spatial_counts[
    ,
    common_spots,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  coordinates <- coordinates[
    common_spots,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  if (!identical(
    colnames(spatial_counts),
    rownames(coordinates)
  )) {
    stop(
      "Spatial counts and coordinates are not aligned for ",
      sample_name
    )
  }


  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Match genes between reference and spatial data
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------

  shared_genes <- intersect(
    rownames(reference_counts),
    rownames(spatial_counts)
  )

  cat(
    "\nCARD input:\n",
    "  Spatial spots: ", ncol(spatial_counts), "\n",
    "  Shared genes:  ", length(shared_genes), "\n",
    sep = ""
  )

  if (length(shared_genes) < minimum_shared_genes) {
    warning(
      "Only ",
      length(shared_genes),
      " shared genes were found for ",
      sample_name
    )
  }

  if (length(shared_genes) == 0) {
    stop(
      "No shared genes were available for CARD in ",
      sample_name
    )
  }

  sc_counts <- reference_counts[
    shared_genes,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  spatial_counts <- spatial_counts[
    shared_genes,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]


  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Create CARD object
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------

  cat(
    "Creating CARD object...\n"
  )

  card_object <- CARD::createCARDObject(
    sc_count = sc_counts,
    sc_meta = reference_metadata,
    spatial_count = spatial_counts,
    spatial_location = coordinates,
    ct.varname = "cellType",
    ct.select = reference_cell_types,
    sample.varname = "sampleInfo",
    minCountGene = min_count_gene,
    minCountSpot = min_count_spot
  )


  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Run CARD deconvolution
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------

  cat(
    "Running CARD deconvolution...\n"
  )

  card_object <- CARD::CARD_deconvolution(
    CARD_object = card_object
  )


  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Extract CARD proportions
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------

  proportions <- as.data.frame(
    card_object@Proportion_CARD,
    check.names = FALSE
  )

  if (nrow(proportions) == 0 ||
      ncol(proportions) == 0) {
    stop(
      "CARD returned an empty proportion matrix for ",
      sample_name
    )
  }

  cat(
    "\nCARD completed:\n",
    "  Spots:      ", nrow(proportions), "\n",
    "  Cell types: ", ncol(proportions), "\n",
    sep = ""
  )

  cat(
    "\nEstimated proportion sums per spot:\n"
  )

  print(
    summary(
      rowSums(
        proportions
      )
    )
  )


  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Save per-sample CARD outputs
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------

  proportion_file <- file.path(
    per_sample_results_directory,
    paste0(
      sample_name,
      "_CARD_proportions.csv"
    )
  )

  shared_gene_file <- file.path(
    per_sample_results_directory,
    paste0(
      sample_name,
      "_CARD_shared_genes.csv"
    )
  )

  object_file <- file.path(
    card_object_directory,
    paste0(
      sample_name,
      "_CARD_object.rds"
    )
  )

  proportions_export <- proportions

  proportions_export$spot <- rownames(
    proportions_export
  )

  utils::write.csv(
    proportions_export,
    proportion_file,
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  shared_gene_table <- data.frame(
    gene = shared_genes,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  utils::write.csv(
    shared_gene_table,
    shared_gene_file,
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  saveRDS(
    object = card_object,
    file = object_file,
    compress = TRUE
  )


  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Validate saved outputs
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------

  if (!file.exists(proportion_file)) {
    stop(
      "CARD proportion file was not saved for ",
      sample_name
    )
  }

  if (!file.exists(object_file)) {
    stop(
      "CARD object was not saved for ",
      sample_name
    )
  }


  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Return results
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------

  return(
    list(
      CARD_object = card_object,
      proportions = proportions,
      spatial_object = sample_object,
      image_name = image_name,
      shared_genes = shared_genes,
      proportion_file = proportion_file,
      shared_gene_file = shared_gene_file,
      object_file = object_file
    )
  )
}


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 15. Run CARD independently across all spatial slides
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n============================================================\n",
  "Running CARD across spatial slides\n",
  "============================================================\n"
)

available_spatial_samples <- unique(
  as.character(
    spatial_object@meta.data[[spatial_sample_column]]
  )
)

samples_to_run <- sample_order[
  sample_order %in%
    available_spatial_samples
]

CARD_results <- list()

for (sample_name in samples_to_run) {
  CARD_results[[sample_name]] <- run_CARD_sample(
    spatial_object = spatial_object,
    sample_name = sample_name,
    reference_counts = reference_counts,
    reference_metadata = reference_metadata,
    reference_cell_types = reference_cell_types,
    spatial_assay = spatial_assay,
    spatial_sample_column = spatial_sample_column,
    image_name = sample_images[[sample_name]],
    card_object_directory = card_object_directory,
    per_sample_results_directory = per_sample_results_directory,
    min_count_gene = card_min_count_gene,
    min_count_spot = card_min_count_spot,
    minimum_shared_genes = minimum_shared_genes
  )
}

CARD_results <- CARD_results[
  !vapply(
    CARD_results,
    is.null,
    logical(1)
  )
]

if (length(CARD_results) == 0) {
  stop(
    "No CARD analyses completed successfully."
  )
}

cat(
  "\nSuccessfully completed CARD samples:\n"
)

print(
  names(
    CARD_results
  )
)

saveRDS(
  object = CARD_results,
  file = all_card_results_file,
  compress = TRUE
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 16. Create shared-gene summary

shared_gene_summary <- data.frame(
  sample = names(CARD_results),
  shared_genes = vapply(
    CARD_results,
    function(x) length(x$shared_genes),

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 17. Define top-three CARD identity function
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

assign_CARD_top3 <- function(
    proportions
) {
  proportions <- as.matrix(
    proportions
  )

  if (ncol(proportions) < 3) {
    stop(
      "CARD proportion matrix contains fewer than three cell types."
    )
  }

  ranked_indices <- t(
    apply(
      proportions,
      1,
      function(x) {
        order(
          x,
          decreasing = TRUE,
          na.last = TRUE
        )
      }
    )
  )

  top1_index <- ranked_indices[, 1]

  top2_index <- ranked_indices[, 2]

  top3_index <- ranked_indices[, 3]

  top1_identity <- colnames(proportions)[
    top1_index
  ]

  top2_identity <- colnames(proportions)[
    top2_index
  ]

  top3_identity <- colnames(proportions)[
    top3_index
  ]

  spot_index <- seq_len(
    nrow(proportions)
  )

  top1_score <- proportions[
    cbind(
      spot_index,
      top1_index
    )
  ]

  top2_score <- proportions[
    cbind(
      spot_index,
      top2_index
    )
  ]

  top3_score <- proportions[
    cbind(
      spot_index,
      top3_index
    )
  ]

  top1_top2_margin <- top1_score -
    top2_score

  top3_total <- top1_score +
    top2_score +
    top3_score

  top3_label <- paste0(
    top1_identity,
    " (",
    round(top1_score, 3),
    "); ",
    top2_identity,
    " (",
    round(top2_score, 3),
    "); ",
    top3_identity,
    " (",
    round(top3_score, 3),
    ")"
  )

  return(
    data.frame(
      CARD_identity = top1_identity,
      CARD_max_score = top1_score,
      CARD_second_identity = top2_identity,
      CARD_second_score = top2_score,
      CARD_third_identity = top3_identity,
      CARD_third_score = top3_score,
      CARD_margin = top1_top2_margin,
      CARD_top3_total = top3_total,
      CARD_top3_label = top3_label,
      row.names = rownames(proportions),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  )
}

# 18. Calculate top-three CARD identities

  CARD_results[[sample_name]]$top3_file <- top3_file
}

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 19. Initialize CARD metadata in master spatial object
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Adding CARD results to master spatial Seurat object\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)

spatial_object$CARD_identity <- NA_character_

spatial_object$CARD_max_score <- NA_real_

spatial_object$CARD_second_identity <- NA_character_

spatial_object$CARD_second_score <- NA_real_

spatial_object$CARD_third_identity <- NA_character_

spatial_object$CARD_third_score <- NA_real_

spatial_object$CARD_margin <- NA_real_

spatial_object$CARD_top3_total <- NA_real_

spatial_object$CARD_top3_label <- NA_character_


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 20. Transfer CARD results into master spatial object
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

transfer_summary <- data.frame()

for (sample_name in names(CARD_results)) {
  proportions <- as.data.frame(
    CARD_results[[sample_name]]$proportions,
    check.names = FALSE
  )

  identities <- CARD_identities[[sample_name]]

  common_spots <- intersect(
    rownames(proportions),
    colnames(spatial_object)
  )

  cat(
    sample_name,
    ": ",
    length(common_spots),
    " CARD spots matched to master object\n",
    sep = ""
  )

  if (length(common_spots) == 0) {
    warning(
      "No CARD spots matched the master object for ",
      sample_name
    )

    next
  }


  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Transfer top-three metadata
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------

  spatial_object@meta.data[
    common_spots,
    "CARD_identity"
  ] <- identities[
    common_spots,
    "CARD_identity"
  ]

  spatial_object@meta.data[
    common_spots,
    "CARD_max_score"
  ] <- identities[
    common_spots,
    "CARD_max_score"
  ]

  spatial_object@meta.data[
    common_spots,
    "CARD_second_identity"
  ] <- identities[
    common_spots,
    "CARD_second_identity"
  ]

  spatial_object@meta.data[
    common_spots,
    "CARD_second_score"
  ] <- identities[
    common_spots,
    "CARD_second_score"
  ]

  spatial_object@meta.data[
    common_spots,
    "CARD_third_identity"
  ] <- identities[
    common_spots,
    "CARD_third_identity"
  ]

  spatial_object@meta.data[
    common_spots,
    "CARD_third_score"
  ] <- identities[
    common_spots,
    "CARD_third_score"
  ]

  spatial_object@meta.data[
    common_spots,
    "CARD_margin"
  ] <- identities[
    common_spots,
    "CARD_margin"
  ]

  spatial_object@meta.data[
    common_spots,
    "CARD_top3_total"
  ] <- identities[
    common_spots,
    "CARD_top3_total"
  ]

  spatial_object@meta.data[
    common_spots,
    "CARD_top3_label"
  ] <- identities[
    common_spots,
    "CARD_top3_label"
  ]


  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Transfer all CARD proportions
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------

  for (cell_type in colnames(proportions)) {
    safe_column_name <- paste0(
      "CARD_",
      make.names(
        cell_type
      )
    )

    if (!safe_column_name %in%
        colnames(spatial_object@meta.data)) {
      spatial_object@meta.data[
        ,
        safe_column_name
      ] <- NA_real_
    }

    spatial_object@meta.data[
      common_spots,
      safe_column_name
    ] <- as.numeric(
      proportions[
        common_spots,
        cell_type
      ]
    )
  }


  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Record transfer summary
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------

  sample_master_spots <- colnames(spatial_object)[
    spatial_object@meta.data[[spatial_sample_column]] ==
      sample_name
  ]

  current_transfer_summary <- data.frame(
    sample = sample_name,
    master_spots = length(sample_master_spots),
    CARD_spots = nrow(proportions),
    matched_spots = length(common_spots),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  transfer_summary <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    transfer_summary,
    current_transfer_summary
  )
}
```
